resources.string: Timer starts on your first move
I escaped Tetra-Escape level %1$d (difficulty %2$d) in %3$d moves with %4$d s to spare.

Tip the glass tetrahedron onto a neighbouring triangle by tapping it. It does not slide – it rolls over an edge, so the symbol that ends up on the bottom changes with every move.

Reach the gold goal before you run out of steps.

Blue cells give extra steps – but only if the symbol lying on the bottom is the one shown in the cell. You will not reach the goal without them.

Purple cells spin the piece a third of a turn every time you land on them.

If the goal shows a symbol, you must arrive with that symbol on the bottom.

The faint symbols in the neighbouring cells show what would land there. The timer starts on your first move.
